senses.definition: n.pr.m. (one who is intelligent, discerning) two Canaanite kings of Hazor;—
Ju 4:2, 7, 17, 23, 24(×2) ψ 83:10. (But cf. Be Ju 4:2 BuRS 66 ff.)
